Riley K: Hey team 1 — heads up my last day is Tue 05/14. Need to confirm SSO/VPN cutover time, COBRA packet window, and whether HSA employer contributions prorate. Also returning Mac + monitor; pickup preferred.
Ana P: Thanks Riley. We typically deprovision SSO at EOD on last day. COBRA packet goes out within 7 business days; 60-day election window. HSA proration depends on payroll cutoff DM Payroll for specifics. Pickup or ship? :package:
Riley K: Pickup please. Any chance to transfer paid JetBrains seat for the remainder of my subscription?
Tess (HR): License transfers are vendor-dependent. If transfer isn't allowed we can reimburse unused months or provide export options. I'll ask DX and loop you in.
Payroll Bot: Payroll cutoff for benefits deductions is 5pm PT on Fri 05/10 for final pay cycle. HSA and 401k proration will follow payroll records.
IT Bot: Pickup request created. Window: Tue 05/16 Wed 05/18. Reply YES to confirm. To print label:
curl -X POST https://ship.example.com/labels -d '{"asset_id":"MAC-4127","addr":"{{user_address}}"}'
Riley K: YES to pickup 05/17. I'll remove personal keys tonight and tag @Matt R for repo transfers.
Security Bot: Reminder: rotate any API keys used on company projects and remove SSH keys from github.com/org.
Matt R: Ping me when you're ready, I'll run the repo audit and help move forks.
Ana P: Exit interview scheduled Mon 05/08 at 11am PT invite sent. Final deprovision EOD Tue 05/14. I'll DM a short offboarding checklist and the COBRA FAQs.
Riley K: Thanks everyone, appreciate the quick help.
